temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt over the past few days; when Keith asks, she denies being upset with him and says she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly due to a misunderstanding or a mistake he made unknowingly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Her curtness is not caused by anger toward him; it is due to personal stress she is dealing with.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him, but she is going through something personal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be considerate and not press her, while remaining open to offering understanding or support if appropriate.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts Keith's offer of a coffee break and thanks him, saying it sounds good.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not upset with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: She is receptive to his support and willing to spend time with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth appreciates his support and is open to a coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To follow through on the coffee break and listen supportively.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe, and says she is hesitant about seeking professional help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is stressed but open to his support; a coffee break might help somewhat.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Her stress is serious, and professional help might benefit her, but she is unsure and hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help may be useful for Elizabeth, but she is not ready or certain about it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, cautious, and worried about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To suggest professional help gently and respect her hesitation without pushing too hard.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after Keith's professional-help suggestion; she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and that it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He is already concerned that his professional-help suggestion may have been too much for her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Her withdrawal initially seems to confirm he may have embarrassed her, but her reassurance indicates he did not overstep.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not offended; she appreciates his concern but needs time to process.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and worried, then relieved but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her of his support and avoid pushing the topic further.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative of Keith's concern; she thanks him and says she feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciated his concern but was processing a lot; he was unsure how comfortable she felt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: She values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better knowing he is there for her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to chat or take breaks together.
